title: Math formulas, level 2: algebra and geometry
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: These are the workhorse formulas of algebra and geometry classes: right triangles, lines on a graph, the quadratic formula, and the volumes of round solids.

How to hold it: Tie each formula to the one it grows from. The distance formula is the Pythagorean theorem on a graph. Slope is rise over run, and the two line equations are slope rearranged. The cone is one third of a cylinder with the same base and height. Learn the parents first, then derive the children once by hand: working it out is the strongest way to encode it. Sing the quadratic formula to a tune you know.
